bi.board.dashboard.none: All certified metrics (not tied to a dashboard)
bi.board.dashboard.unpublished: This dashboard has no published version, so there are no metrics and no signatures to show.
bi.board.dashboard.noMetrics: The published version of this dashboard no longer holds a metric that is certified.
bi.board.sign.unbound: This board is not tied to the published version of a dashboard, so it has no prepared, checked or approved signature; it is not a signed report.
bi.board.dashboard.pinned: This dashboard pins its dataset versions at publication: only the pinned periods can be chosen, so the signatures stay with the figures that were approved.
